title: BDK Project Settings
description: Project-level configuration for the Broneq Dev Kit (.bdk/settings.json)

languages.description: Languages and frameworks detected in this project. Free-form: an entry only needs a matching rules/languages/<name>.md (shipped or user-supplied) to inject anything. See .claude/rules/language-rules.md.

test-tools.description: Commands to run the test suite

lavish.description: Route bundled multi-question decision points through the lavish-axi binary instead of terminal AskUserQuestion. Also requires the binary on PATH; skills check both and fall back silently when either is absent.

quality.description: Per-category overrides for BDK's language-agnostic rules in rules/<name>.md. Read by scripts/inject-rules.py. Keys are rule names (code-quality, architecture, design-patterns, security, engineering-judgment).

language-rules.description: Per-language overrides for rules/languages/<lang>.md. Read by scripts/inject-language-rules.py. Keys are entries from `languages`.

ruleOverride.description: Either a bare path to the override file, or an object choosing how it combines with the BDK default.

path.description: Path to the override file, relative to project root

mode.description: extends appends the override to the BDK default; replace discards the default
